text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Hanshin JF. Sweep Tosho 
grows increasingly annoyed by Air Groove 
fussing and worrying over every little 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho was pouting. However, the 
Trainer didn't treat her like a child, 
simply saying "I believe in you" before 
sending her off to the race.
